brief.name: Gatekeeper
brief.levelTheme: Bastion Relay: inside the enemy base. Wardens hold the line, red gates sweep on a beat, crushers slam the halls. The crown deck sits past the gatehouse.
brief.bossFiction: The base gatekeeper on the crown deck: a treaded relay-dome with antennae, conduit seams, and one alert-red lens. She paces, charges, and calls wardens to the guard.
brief.rule: Jump her charge late, duel each summoned warden, keep bolts on the lens.
brief.tell: Crouch and red flash for 800ms means a 378px charge; gold flash and rear-up for 600ms births one warden.
brief.safeResponse: Plant on the pace, strafe the telegraph, jump as the charge leaves, gun down the newborn before it spreads.
brief.enrage: Below half HP she rests shorter and births 30% faster with the same charge speed, tinted purple with an ENRAGED banner.
brief.defeat: Explosion, GATEKEEPER DOWN banner, crown shield opens. Summoned adds dissolve. Wounds persist through player death.
